fields.meaning: Tax Identification Code issued by the Cyprus Tax Department — the company's tax id, separate from the HE registration number and the VAT number.
fields.limitations: Not present in the open DRCIP CSV; obtained per company. No bulk list.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to tax_id. Join back to the company via registration_number where the two are linked.

fields.meaning: Cyprus VAT number: 'CY' + 8 digits + a trailing letter (e.g. CY12345678X). Separate from TIC and HE.
fields.limitations: VIES validates a supplied number; it does not enumerate/list companies.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to vat_id; validate via VIES.

fields.meaning: Validity of a given VAT number per VIES (valid/invalid).
fields.limitations: Point-in-time validation only; rate-limited EU service.
fields.analysis_notes: Use to confirm a VAT number, not to discover companies.
